rbac.description: Controls creation of ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding resources.

create.description: When set to false, the ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding will not be created.

manageNetworkPolicies.description: When set to true, grants the controller permission to manage NetworkPolicy resources (create, update, patch, delete). Required for network policy enforcement features.

role.description: Configuration for the ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding.

name.description: Name of the ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding.

subject.description: Subject to bind in the ClusterRoleBinding. If omitted, no subject is added (useful when only a ServiceAccount binding is needed).

kind.description: Kind of the subject (e.g. Group, User, ServiceAccount).

namespace.description: Namespace of the subject. Only applicable when kind is ServiceAccount.

serviceAccount.description: Controls creation of a ServiceAccount and its token Secret.

create.description: When set to true, a ServiceAccount with a ServiceAccountToken is created and referenced by the ClusterRoleBinding.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount and the prefix for its token Secret.
